# smtp-mail-catcher

Development SMTP server that captures every message, parses MIME parts and attachments and shows them in a safe local web interface. Go module `github.com/Trysac/u920-smtp-mail-catcher`, package `smtpmailcatcher`, MIT licensed, Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): tools used and discarded
